_why: goal-interview --start --said <owner's words>: the tool, not the model, reads whether the opening words already chose a fresh start (live 2026-10-10 22:15, the health agent: '목표상담 처음부터' still got the 3-way fork because --intent rebuild was a prose rule). ko entries match on the text with whitespace removed (substring); en entries match whole words, case-folded. Order of reading: add; fresh_start + whole_set = rebuild; adjust; fresh_start alone = rebuild unless the words name ONE active goal / strand (then adjust: the request keeps its intent). keep (2026-10-11, rehearsal S6.keep_words): the owner keeps the current card ('그대로 둘게요', '바꿀 거 없어요', '유지') -- read after add and fresh_start + whole_set, before adjust and a lone fresh_start (a keep phrase like '바꿀 거 없어요' carries an adjust word, '다시 보니 그대로 둘게요' a fresh-start one); with a full card it returns the move loop's wrap, as the fork's keep pick does.
